data.description: The Bike Spring Rider is shaped like a red motorbike, with a seat and handlebars, mounted on a spring. A child climbs on, grips the handlebars and rocks it as if riding. Children who are too young for a real cycle love the pretend ride, and it gives them practice in balance and holding on. The Play Red colour stands out in a toddler corner and pairs well with a road or traffic theme. It needs very little ground, so a play school or society garden can fit it alongside other riders. Our 3-year warranty covers its roto-moulded body, and the spring carries 1 year. Ask us for a quote on a set of riders.

items.pText: The Bike Spring Rider is shaped like a red motorbike, with a seat and handlebars, mounted on a spring. A child climbs on, grips the handlebars and rocks it as if riding. Children who are too young for a real cycle love the pretend ride, and it gives them practice in balance and holding on. The Play Red colour stands out in a toddler corner and pairs well with a road or traffic theme. It needs very little ground, so a play school or society garden can fit it alongside other riders. Our 3-year warranty covers its roto-moulded body, and the spring carries 1 year. Ask us for a quote on a set of riders.

The bike body is roto-moulded and fixed to a steel spring. We set it up self-standing or grouted. Use an impact-absorbing surface under the rider, keep space around it for its rocking movement, and check the handlebars, spring and base bolts during routine maintenance.
